disagreements.verdict: Reconciled to ~26%. All three figures are compatible (realized 23-28%, implied slightly above); implied is the right input because CPI, the ECB, a live FOMC with dots and quad witching all fall inside the 9-session window.

disagreements.claim: S&P leg vol is 8% annualized realized (R1's measured 0.50pp/day) vs VIX 14.32 implied
disagreements.verdict: Both correct as measured; realized has run well below implied on a calm tape. Reconciled to ~12.5% for this specific event-heavy window, between the two.

disagreements.claim: Iran/Hormuz escalation is a gold-positive up-tail (R1, R3) vs gold-NEGATIVE via oil to inflation to higher real rates (R2)
disagreements.verdict: No evidence breaks the tie - both channels are documented for 2026 in the dossiers. My bet: moderate oil strength is gold-ambiguous, an outright Strait closure is risk-off-dominant, so keep mild positive skew rather than R1/R3's cleaner up-tail or R2's near-full discount.

disagreements.claim: No prediction market, dealer quote, or bookmaker prices a gold-versus-equity relative return over any two-week horizon
disagreements.verdict: Settled - three independent searches of Kalshi, Polymarket, Manifold and books converged on 'levels and direction only'. The nearest contract is Polymarket's calendar-2026 three-way (GC00 vs ^SPX, full-year horizon, different instruments and resolution source), usable as a dispersion cross-check but not as an anchor. No crowd blend applied.
